document.about: Sherwin-Williams environmental data sheet. Each page sets small ruled VOC tables under larger ones and under full-width section banners.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#200): the two short VOC tables restate their units, `VOC Content | LB/Gal | g/L`, bold over their one `Total` row. A restated header needed two rows under it, and the `Total` values were named `By wt` and `By vol`, the units of the rows above.
